description: Restricted Roads (LGATE-134) is a dataset listed in Western Australian Government data catalogue (catalogue.data.wa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Landgate. This road centreline dataset is derived from the Road segment layer of Landgate’s medium scale Topographic GeoDatabase (TGDB). It is a depiction of the state’s road and tracks system. All named segments link to Landgate’s Geonoma Database via NameID. This restricted dataset has been provided for use by authorised Emergency Management agencies. Coverage: Western Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Landgate. Its tags are emergency, landgate, lgate, private, restricted. It offers 7 resource(s) in api arcgis server map service, fgdb, geopackage, pdf, shp. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Custom (Other). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-au-wa-portal.
